projectDescription: A modular runtime framework for Windows 11, built with C++20 and Windows SDK service adapters. The WinUI 3 host application template is planned and is not yet a repository target.
principles: Strict modularity: all features live inside first- or third-party modules
Framework-mediated everything: modules never talk to each other directly
Single active UI/app surface module at a time; unlimited service modules
UI/app contributions must declare matching capabilities before activation

layers.name: ForsettiCore
layers.description: Pure C++20 foundation. No platform dependencies.

layers.name: ForsettiModulesExample
layers.description: Example first-party modules for testing and reference.

layers.name: ForsettiHostTemplate
layers.description: Planned WinUI 3 host application template with framework chrome.

architecture.dependencyRule: One-way only. Core depends on nothing. Platform depends on Core. The planned HostTemplate layer depends on Core and Platform. ModulesExample depends on Core only. No reverse or lateral dependencies.

activationSemantics.serviceModules: Multiple service modules may be active at the same time.
activationSemantics.uiAndAppModules: UI and app modules share one active surface slot. Activating one replaces the previous UI/app module and its surface contributions.

hostAppContract.description: The planned ForsettiHostTemplate will provide turnkey integration. Current host applications build custom hosts using ForsettiCore + ForsettiPlatform.
